subject: Initial phone screen — proposing split-day time buckets
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Javier Santos <javier.santos@example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 15:44:00 +0530
Subject: Initial phone screen — proposing split-day time buckets

Hi Javier,

Thanks for applying to the Platform Engineer role — excited to connect. I'm Karthik on the recruiting team; Laura (cc'd) will likely join the call as the hiring manager. To make scheduling simple across time zones, I usually offer 3 compact "time-buckets" (30m each) across two days so candidates can pick a block that fits their day. All times below include a CDT conversion for your convenience.

Option A (morning your time)
- Tue Dec 1: 09:00–09:30 CDT (19:30–20:00 IST)

Option B (late morning / lunch overlap)
- Tue Dec 1: 12:30–13:00 CDT (22:00–22:30 IST)

Option C (afternoon your time)
- Wed Dec 2: 16:00–16:30 CDT (02:30–03:00 IST on Thu)

If none of those work, tell me two 1-hour windows (range) over the next 3 days and I can propose a precise slot. I've attached my availability as an .ics in case you want to drop one into your calendar.

Also, if you have any accessibility needs or need a different interviewer format, please let me know.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +91 98X-XXX-XXXX

Attachments: recruiter-availability.ics

From: Javier Santos <javier.santos@example.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia (assistant) <alicia.asst@example.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial phone screen — proposing split-day time buckets

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the clear options. I appreciate the converted times — that helps a lot. Quick note: I have a standing lunch meeting around 12:00–13:00 CDT on Tue, so Option B will conflict. Option A is doable but a bit early for me that day; Option C on Wed at 16:00 CDT is ideal.

If it's helpful, I can do Wed Dec 2 at 16:00 CDT. Laura joining works for me. I'm attaching my resume here for your records.

—Javier

Attachments: resume-javier-santos.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Javier Santos <javier.santos@example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 01:08:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Initial phone screen — proposing split-day time buckets

Hi Javier — great, thanks for confirming. Wed Dec 2 16:00 CDT works for Laura and me. I'll send a calendar invite shortly; provisional invite details below (will include dial-in and a short agenda):

- Title: Redwood Inference — Initial Phone Screen (Javier Santos)
- When: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 • 16:00–16:30 CDT / 02:30–03:00 IST (Thu)
- Attendees: Javier Santos; Karthik Iyer (Recruiter); Laura Bennett (Hiring Manager)
- Agenda: 30m — quick intro, role fit, high-level technical discussion, next steps

Forwarding the invite now. If you need to swap to an earlier Wed slot, tell me and I'll adjust.

Best,
Karthik

From: Javier Santos <javier.santos@example.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 00:53:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial phone screen — proposing split-day time buckets

Sounds good — I accepted the calendar invite and see the agenda. Looking forward to speaking with you both. If anything changes I or Alicia will update the invite.

Thanks,
Javier
